acceptanceCriteria: A proposed amendment to AFP-V0-041 (docs/specs/affected-plan-v0.md) defines how ci-test-slices generate and replay combine the per-slice terminal outcomes of a package that is already split, the way ci-shard-costs refresh does. Lane requirements are accepted under the owner's standing auto-accept of 2026-10-11.

ci-test-slices generate and replay accept a go1.27.2 FULL run that ran split packages, for example internal/tasks/store, and still refuse a genuinely duplicated or conflicting outcome for the same unit.
test-slices.json is regenerated from a hosted go1.27.2 FULL run. The partition replay places every unit exactly once, and the go1.27.1 slice source is superseded per decision 0522.
Hostile tests for the combination rule. The .github/ change carries AFP-V0-016 consent on its reviewed head, and sealed change evidence is retained.
body: Blocker found by the V1-1241 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#880, 2026-10-14). `ci-test-slices generate` and `replay` refuse every CI run since #736 with 'internal/tasks/store has two terminal outcomes', because that package now runs as AFP-V0-041 slices and each slice reports its own terminal outcome. AFP-V0-041 (5) requires that refusal, so .github/cishards/test-slices.json cannot be regenerated from any go1.27.2 run. It stays sourced from go1.27.1 run 38078093034, which SourceGoVersions still admits. ci-shard-costs refresh already combines a split package's slice costs, and the cost table was refreshed to go1.27.2 in #880 from run 38485555207. Expected: a split package's slice outcomes combine into one per-package (or per-slice) record. Actual: the tool refuses the run. V1-1241 depends on this ticket for its test-slice clause.
title: ci-test-slices refuses every run since #736: split package internal/tasks/store has two terminal outcomes (blocks go1.27.2 slice table)
